h1: Custom Dolman Pullovers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom dolman pullovers in bulk. Perfect for team uniforms or giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Dolman pullovers offer a relaxed, modern silhouette with wide sleeves that taper at the wrist, making them a popular choice for casual corporate apparel and employee gifts. The loose fit suits a range of body types, and the open cuffs allow easy screen printing or embroidery on the front and sleeves. Whether you're outfitting a retail team or creating a comfortable uniform for a trade show, custom dolman pullovers provide a stylish alternative to standard crewnecks.
heroAltText: Custom dolman pullovers with wide sleeves and relaxed fit, perfect for branding with screen printing or embroidery.
